title: Metals vs Non-metals
guideExplore: Pick any metal and non-metal, then compare how well each conducts electricity and how reactive it is.
guideConductivity: Watch electrons flow freely through the metal wire — but stay stuck in the non-metal.
guideReactivity: Turn up reactivity and watch the metal sample react with the non-metal to form an oxide.
guideCompare: Metals are shiny, malleable, and conduct well. Non-metals are dull, brittle, and mostly insulate.
conditionsHint: Higher reactivity makes the metal react with the non-metal faster, forming an oxide coating.
learnMore: Metals have loosely held outer (valence) electrons that form a 'sea of electrons' — free to carry current and to react by losing electrons to non-metals.
quizWrong: Their electrons are locked in fixed positions
